mechanism: Carisoprodol may impair GI motility and delay alendronate absorption, while both drugs can cause GI irritation; carisoprodol's CNS effects may reduce patient compliance with alendronate's strict dosing requirements.
action: Separate dosing by at least 30 minutes to 2 hours; ensure patient remains upright after alendronate; monitor for adequate GI tolerance and medication adherence.
